from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u080/system/state/workspace/programs'); base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    points=[(r,c,v) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
    fives=[(r,c) for r,c,v in points if v==5]
    if len(fives)<2: return g
    # The motif containing the 5 serves as a stamp; the other 5 is its destination.
    # Choose the 5 with the greatest number of nearby nonzero cells as motif anchor.
    def score(a):
        r,c=a
        return sum(abs(rr-r)<=3 and abs(cc-c)<=3 for rr,cc,v in points if v!=5)
    anchor=max(fives,key=score)
    dest=next(p for p in fives if p!=anchor)
    dr,dc=dest[0]-anchor[0],dest[1]-anchor[1]
    for r,c,v in points:
        if v==5: continue
        nr,nc=r+dr,c+dc
        if 0<=nr<len(g) and 0<=nc<len(g[0]): g[nr][nc]=v
    return g
'''
(base/'task-58bcf697.py').write_text(code)
exec(code)
